name: doc-kit
description: Documents an agent writes for people, in one look.

plugins.name: doc-kit
plugins.description: Eight skills: doc-kit (the look: one prebuilt CSS, a fixed set of parts, a checker), picture-manual (a tool's manual as wishes and before/after pictures), explainer and explainer-book (explanations and books for one reader, verified by tools), first-reader (simulated beta readers, Apache-2.0), d2-diagram and d2-slides, yomiyasu (rewriting AI-written Japanese, and its lint; a copy of nanaism/yomiyasu, MIT).
